brief: Make it feel premium. Build the launch page for Cinder Supply, a small-batch coffee roaster. Feature the 250 g Alto Carmo at $19 with notes of cacao and plum, roasted November 19. Help a first-time buyer choose one bag and add it to their bag. Audience is curious home brewers. Brand should feel warm and exact. No existing imagery or brand kit.

Make this look good. Build Linehaul, a dispatcher dashboard for the morning logistics shift. Show five loads, with LS-057 at Bay 4 delayed 19 minutes and LS-061 due in nine minutes. Let the dispatcher find and focus the delay. Audience is dispatchers on a time limit. Brand should feel direct and calm. No existing brand kit.

Make it modern. Build a mobile web ticket screen for Spur commuter rail. A rider needs to see the 08:42 Union departure from Platform 3 and reveal ticket TKT-0837. There is an 08:58 alternative and weekly pass option. Audience is a rider walking to the platform. Prioritize speed and good readability. No existing brand kit.

Make it stand out. Build a portfolio for Field Office, a landscape design practice. Feature Mill Race, a 2.4-acre restored riverside park completed in 2025, alongside Rain Court and Slope Garden. Help a prospective client open the Mill Race case study and find contact. Brand should feel spacious and material. No existing imagery or brand kit.

Make it pop. Build the public pricing page for Relay Notes, an interview transcription app. Solo is $12/month with 10 hours, Team is $28/month with 40 hours and shared vocabulary, and Studio is $60 with 120 hours and approvals. Help researchers choose a plan and continue. Brand should feel clear and assured. No existing brand kit.

Idk make it good. Build the home of Saltline, a small food magazine. Feature The Coast at Low Tide, a 7-minute field report by Mara Vega, with a sidebar dispatch on the evening fish market and a recipe for lemon broth. Help readers open the feature. Audience is curious home cooks. Brand should feel tactile and observant. No existing imagery or brand kit.
